purpose: Freeze complete corpus and quantify saved-forecast fidelity before new model experiments
source_database: resolve from all four installed Tennis launchd plists; must agree
snapshot: SQLite backup of one pinned read transaction; all tables, rows and indexes; create-only external archive
quote_policy: MIN(id) match_winner quote per match; no later fallback; fetched_at <= created_at <= forecast_created_at < frozen_or_legacy_start; aware clocks required
parity: saved Elo base + saved active nudge weights/probabilities, +/-1.2 nudge cap, .02/.98 raw clamp, saved selection side, saved segment risk shrink
full_source_provenance: not inferred from SQLite timing, fixture identity or parity; remains unverified until canonical frozen-bundle verifier succeeds
stop: missing/corrupt catalog data, snapshot count mismatch, unmounted archive, missing runtime identity or conflicting runtime paths
